args.content:
Hawaii Vacation Packing List
June 10-20, 2024

ESSENTIALS:
- Valid ID/Passport
- Travel insurance documents
- Hotel reservation confirmations
- Flight tickets/boarding passes
- Credit cards and cash
- Phone and charger
- Camera and charger
- Portable power bank
- Travel adapter (if needed)

CLOTHING:
- Swimwear (at least 2-3 sets)
- Lightweight, breathable clothing
- Casual outfits for dinners
- Light jacket or sweater (for evenings)
- Comfortable walking shoes
- Flip-flops/sandals
- Water shoes (for snorkeling at Hanauma Bay)
- Hat with brim for sun protection
- Sunglasses

BEACH & WATER ACTIVITIES:
- Beach towels
- Reef-safe sunscreen (SPF 50+)
- After-sun lotion/aloe vera
- Waterproof phone case
- Snorkel gear (mask, snorkel, fins)
- Beach bag
- Cooler for beach days

HIKING & OUTDOOR ACTIVITIES:
- Hiking boots/shoes (for Diamond Head)
- Moisture-wicking socks
- Quick-dry hiking pants/shorts
- Long-sleeve lightweight shirt (sun protection)
- Small backpack/daypack
- Water bottle/hydration system
- Trail snacks
- Insect repellent

LUAU & SPECIAL EVENTS:
- Hawaiian shirt or aloha wear (for luau)
- Dress or nice outfit for special dinners
- Jewelry/accessories

TOILETRIES:
- Toothbrush and toothpaste
- Shampoo and conditioner
- Body wash
- Deodorant
- Hairbrush/comb
- Prescription medications
- First aid kit
- Lip balm with SPF

MISCELLANEOUS:
- Books/e-reader for relaxation
- Travel pillow
- Earplugs
- Eye mask
- Reusable water bottle
- Plastic bags for wet items
- Laundry bag

ACTIVITY-SPECIFIC ITEMS:
- June 11 (Waikiki Beach): Beach umbrella, beach games
- June 12 (Hanauma Bay snorkeling): Underwater camera, rash guard
- June 13 (Diamond Head hiking): Trekking poles, trail map
- June 14 (Pearl Harbor): Comfortable walking shoes, respectful attire
- June 15 (North Shore road trip): Car snacks, playlist/music
- June 16 (Luau): Hawaiian accessories, comfortable seating cushion
- June 17 (Spa day): Spa sandals, robe (if not provided)
- June 18 (Kailua Beach kayaking): Quick-dry clothes, waterproof watch
- June 19 (Shopping): Reusable shopping bags, list of items to purchase
